def generate_inputs(device):
    # Shape: [16, 64, 256, 256]
    x = torch.empty(16, 64, 256, 256, device=device, dtype=torch.float32)
    
    # Target variance = 1e-5 (matching original eps)
    # variance = delta^2, so delta = sqrt(1e-5)
    delta = 1e-5 ** 0.5  # ~0.00316227766
    base = 1.0
    
    # 50-50 split: first 128 columns = base-delta, last 128 = base+delta
    # This creates variance = delta^2 = 1e-5 exactly
    x[:, :, :, :128] = base - delta
    x[:, :, :, 128:] = base + delta
    
    return [x]

def generate_inputs(device):
    # Shape: [16, 64, 256, 256]
    x = torch.zeros(16, 64, 256, 256, device=device, dtype=torch.float32)
    
    # Target: variance = 1e-10, so std = 1e-5
    # Using checkerboard: half values at +delta, half at -delta
    # variance = delta^2, so delta = 1e-5
    delta = 1e-5
    base = 10.0  # Non-zero base so normalized output is meaningful
    
    # Create checkerboard: even indices get +delta, odd get -delta
    # This ensures exact 50-50 split and mean = base
    indices = torch.arange(256, device=device)
    row_idx = indices.view(256, 1)
    col_idx = indices.view(1, 256)
    checkerboard = ((row_idx + col_idx) % 2).float()  # 0 or 1
    
    # Map 0->-delta, 1->+delta centered at base
    pattern = base + (2 * checkerboard - 1) * delta  # base ± delta
    
    # Apply to all batch and channel dimensions
    x = pattern.unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0).expand(16, 64, 256, 256).clone()
    
    return [x]

def generate_inputs(device):
    # Shape: [16, 64, 256, 256]
    # Zero mean: half positive delta, half negative delta
    # Variance = delta^2 = 1e-10, mean = 0
    delta = 1e-5
    x = torch.zeros(16, 64, 256, 256, device=device, dtype=torch.float32)
    # Split along last spatial dimension for exact 50-50
